packageRules.description: One PR, not one per dependency.

description: The Nix manager is beta and has to be turned on explicitly, or
Renovate never looks at flake.nix/flake.lock at all. It also refreshes
the advisory-db input the `audit` check reads.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Refreshes both Cargo.lock and flake.lock even when no manifest range has changed.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security advisories skip the release-age grace period; everything else about review and auto-merge still applies.
